text: This solution, USAID’s Tayar Nepal – Improved Disaster Risk Management Project (Tayar Nepal) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority/Agency (NDRRMA), Municipal Governments, United States Agency for International Development (USAID/Nepal), and DAI Global LLC. The program was implemented in 2019 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and accessibility.
